title_zh: 弄清课程结业证书的取得条件

scenario.label_zh: 询问课程结业证书要求
scenario.goal_zh: 澄清出勤、项目与考试要求，并索取书面说明以便在报名前核对时间

context_zh: 学员在决定是否报名之前，向课程工作人员核对结业要求。
author: author-phase07-a

sentences.speaker: Cleo
sentences.text: The course page mentions a certificate. Do you receive it just for attending?

sentences.speaker: Mason
sentences.text: No. We issue it on completion of the final project, provided you've also attended four of the five sessions.

sentences.speaker: Cleo
sentences.text: Is the last session compulsory? I may be away that evening.

sentences.speaker: Mason
sentences.text: Attendance at that session isn't compulsory, but the project still has to be submitted by Friday.

sentences.speaker: Cleo
sentences.text: That sounds less complicated than I thought. Is there an exam as well?

sentences.speaker: Mason
sentences.text: No exam. The project is the only assessed piece of work. I can send you the written requirements.

sentences.speaker: Cleo
sentences.text: Please do. I'll check the dates against my travel plans before I sign up.
